# Security, Feed and Performance Checklist: The blog ("Drift & Convergence")

**Purpose**: Validate requirements for the content security policy, feed, metadata and performance budget that the blog's build-time highlighting, scripts and images put at risk.
**Created**: 2026-09-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items ask whether requirements are well written; none is evaluated yet.

## Content Security Policy and Scripts

- [ ] CHK001 Is "CSP unchanged" stated as a requirement in the spec, not only the plan, and is what counts as a change defined? [Gap, Plan §Constraints]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the requirement that highlighted code carries no inline styles stated with a measurable acceptance condition? [Measurability, Plan §R7]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the scripts permitted on a post page enumerated (copy button, share button) and consistent with "the copy button MUST be the only script the post body needs"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-025, Plan §Constitution Check V]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the behaviour for an unknown highlight language defined for authors (plain text fallback versus build failure)? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, Plan §R7]
- [ ] CHK005 Are share links required to carry only the post title and address, with no tracking parameters? [Completeness, Plan §Constitution Check VII]

## Feed and Metadata

- [ ] CHK006 Is the feed address specified in the spec, not only in the contract? [Gap, Spec §FR-036]
- [ ] CHK007 Are feed item fields defined for update dates, absolute addresses and summary escaping? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, FR-036]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "a feed that feed readers accept" made measurable by naming the validator and pass condition? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the feed's behaviour with zero published posts specified as valid and empty? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 Are page metadata requirements defined for landing, listing and topic pages, not only post pages? [Gap, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK011 Are canonical address and search-engine treatment of paginated pages specified? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the sitemap's content for blog pages and exclusion of drafts consistent with the feed requirement? [Consistency, Spec §FR-032]

## Performance

- [ ] CHK013 Is "within the site's existing performance budget" quantified in the spec, or only by reference to the plan's numbers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-041, Plan §Performance Goals]
- [ ] CHK014 Are image requirements (dimensions, formats, responsive sizes, lazy loading, hero priority) defined to protect LCP and CLS? [Gap, Spec §FR-019, FR-023]
- [ ] CHK015 Is layout stability specified for the swap between share button and plain links and for the overlapping title card? [Gap, Spec §FR-028, FR-019]
- [ ] CHK016 Is a page weight expectation stated for a post with wide and full-width images, given the budget's total limit? [Gap, Spec §FR-041]
- [ ] CHK017 Are budget requirements defined for listing pages with 12 image cards? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012]
